title: Meeting Brother Montgomery in the 1920s
summary: The interviewer asks when and where Tuts met Little Brother Montgomery; it was back in the 1920s, near Second Street.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: A little brother man, I've been knowing him for years. When did you meet him the first time and where? Oh man that was back in the thirties. Not earlier. It might have been in the 29 man. Around before the thirties. It was before the thirties. Oh yeah. It was before the thirties when I met little brother. Let me see now. It's been so long. His last name is Montgomery. That's right. That's right. That was way back in the 20s. You can remember that. In the 20s. Yeah. It was in the 20s. He used to live right around here on 2nd in, I think 2nd between Pruitt and Johnson or either.
